en.title: Land in Southern Chile — buy with local insight | Land Advisors
en.description: Independent land advisory in Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue and Malalcahuello. We help buyers choose the right lot with local market insight — not a brokerage listing pitch.

#inicio h1.en:
We help you buy
the right land.

#inicio .hero-lead.en: We don't sell land. We're independent advisors: we read the local market and the ground under it so you buy with less risk and better leverage — around Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello.

#inicio .hero-metrics .hero-metric:nth-c.en: Anyone buying land in the south

#problema .section-title.en: Listings are everywhere. Local judgment isn't.

#problema .section-intro.en: Portals and brokerages post options every day. What's missing is how to read the rural fringe, compare apples to apples, and know if the price is real — before you fly south.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(1) ..en: «I saw dozens of listings and don't know which to compare»
Too much information, too little order. You need filters before you visit.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(2) ..en: «I love the place — but does it fit my project?»
Home, cabins, or a business: check the land and the surroundings before you make an offer.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(3) ..en: «I live in Santiago and don't know how things work locally»
Drive time, access, and how the area is changing can flip the decision.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(4) ..en: We know how to separate a good deal from a bad one — and help you negotiate with that.

#confianza .section-confianza__metric.en: More than 100,000 UF invested with clients we advised

#consecuencias .section-intro.en: Buying without an independent advisor doesn't always fail — but when it does, you pay in time and money.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(1) p.en: Access, HOA-style subdivision rules, or distance to services the listing barely mentioned.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(2) p.en: Paying for the photo without checking real comps in the area.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(3) h3.en: A project that can't get built

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(3) p.en: Cabins or retail in your head — on land where that use isn't viable.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(4) p.en: Flying south without a map or priorities — exhausting, and thin on results.

#solucion .section-title.en: Your partner on the buy side

#solucion .section-intro.en: We work for the buyer. Years buying land in Southern Chile means fewer wasted trips, clearer options, and someone in your corner when you compare and negotiate.

#solucion .pensamos-lead.en: Less noise. Better decisions. An ally who already knows this basin.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(1.en: We save you trips: zones, prices, and red flags before you go south.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(2.en: We read what the listing leaves out
Access, subdivision rules, neighbors, and where the area is headed — in plain English.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(3.en: If it isn't the right lot, we say so — and keep looking with you.

#casos .section-title.en: What changes when you look before you buy

#casos .section-intro.en: Three decisions around Lago Llanquihue. Past results don't guarantee future ones — they show how we work when we have market and on-the-ground data.

#casos .case:nth-child(1) h3 a.en: From a use ban to commercial potential

#casos .case:nth-child(1) .case-dl dd:nt.en: Commercial-looking land with a ban on commercial use.
Access, traffic, and town growth that pointed to a real commercial future.
Bought with the restriction in place; after it was lifted, about 50% upside vs. the price paid.

#casos .case:nth-child(2) h3 a.en: The edge was in the seller

#casos .case:nth-child(2) .case-dl dd:nt.en: One more lot on the market.
A motivated seller and a gap between asking price and real value.
Bought at 26 million; sold at 42 million in two months.

#casos .case:nth-child(3) .case-dl dd:nt.en: A developer short on cash — and upside once the project was finished.
Four lots for 4,400 UF; recent comps near ~2,000 UF per lot.

#servicios .section-title.en: Start where you are — no need to buy the whole stack

#servicios .section-intro.en: Each service covers a different stage. Most people start with a strategy call (Diagnostic, 1 UF).

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(1) p.en: Get organized: zones, budget, and a visit plan before you go south.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(2) p.en: At least 4 options → we narrow to the 3 best with you, then a clear comparison.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(3) p.en: Negotiation and closing support — no pressure to push a specific listing.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(3) .s.en: minus 5 UF if you already hired search

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(4) p.en: Is this lot actually a good buy? Deep dive before you commit capital.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(5) p.en: Cabins, tourism, or retail: feasibility and a plan before you build.

#oportunidades .section-intro.en: Simple and repeatable — whether you're buying to live, invest, or build a project.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(1) p.en: A call to lock budget, timing, and what you want the land to do.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(2) p.en: Zones, prices, access, and risk signals — with fieldwork and market comps.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(3) p.en: A clear recommendation, help negotiating if needed, and honesty if you should keep looking.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(1) .faq-answer.en: No. We're not a brokerage or a listing portal. We advise buyers — with zero pressure to push a specific lot.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(2) .faq-answer.en: A strategy call (Diagnostic, 1 UF): we learn your goal and give you zones and filters before you start visiting land.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(3) summary.en: Does this work if I live in Santiago?

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(3) .faq-answer.en: Yes. Plenty of clients live outside the region. We help you arrive with a map and priorities — not a blind road trip.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(4) summary.en: What if the land I like isn't a good buy?

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(4) .faq-answer.en: We'll tell you straight and keep searching with you. Our job is a good purchase, not a fast one.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(5) .faq-answer.en: Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello: Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue, Ensenada, Puerto Octay, and the rural fringe around those towns.

#contacto-form-intro.en: Tell us where you are in the process. After you submit, pick a calendar slot or confirm with José on WhatsApp.

#contacto .contact-info p:nth-of-type(4).en: We work with long-term investors, families chasing quality of life, developers, and local business owners across Southern Chile.

#contacto-form .form-hint.en: Most people start with a Diagnostic to get the search organized.

.contact-success__title.en: Done — how do you want to book?

.contact-success__lead.en: Land Advisors has your details. Pick the next step:

.contact-success__note.en: Diagnostic ~30 min · Online or in Puerto Varas · We reply Mon–Fri.

#cta h2.en: Ready to buy with a clear plan?

#cta p.en: A ~30-minute Diagnostic to understand your goal — no obligation to buy.

#innovacion .section-title.en: Tools that back the judgment call

#innovacion .section-intro-wide.en: When we compare lots to buy or pressure-test a cabin / retail / development idea, we use maps, satellite views, public records, and AI on top of real fieldwork. Tech doesn't replace walking the land — it helps us get there faster with fewer misses.

#territorios .section-title.en: Markets we know from the ground

#territorios .section-intro.en: We focus on the Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello basin — especially the rural fringe around the main towns. For bigger Patagonia briefs we also run custom search with local broker partners and site visits when the deal needs it.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(1).en: Land Advisors Chile is led by José Hernán Katz C. — a Southern Chile specialist in land strategy, acquisitions, and project feasibility.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(2).en: We pair boots-on-the-ground work with GIS, mapping, and AI so families, investors, and operators can buy with eyes open and test projects with real backing.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(3).en: We're closer to an explorer than a salesperson: we walk the roads, visit the lots, and learn places from the inside — then back that up with checkable data.

#partners .section-intro.en: We work with strong local partners to help you get a project done in Southern Chile.

#innovacion .inno-card--hero h3.en: AI grounded in local files — not generic chat

#innovacion .inno-card--hero p.en: We connect AI to our own library of zoning notes, maps, market comps, and on-the-ground experience. Answers come with sources you can check — not a generic chatbot guess.

#innovacion .inno-card--hero .inno-card-.en: Pull the file → add local context → recommend with proof.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(2) p.en: Land use, access, and town growth layered into one read of the area.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(3) p.en: Google Earth and remote sensing to spot patterns the listing price hasn't caught up with.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(4) h3.en: AI on market and zoning data

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(4) p.en: We process a lot of regulatory and real-estate data — with a trail back to the source.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(5) p.en: Public data, planning maps, local market, and site visits in a single decision flow.

#innovacion .inno-card--wide p.en: We're not chasing AI for the pitch deck. We use tools so human judgment — after you've walked the lot — lands in a clear buy / pass / negotiate call tied to your goal.
